apps.title: open_agb_firm
apps.description: Run GBA games and homebrew on the 3DS built-in GBA hardware, with direct SD saves and a ROM browser.
apps.requirements: Original and New 3DS/2DS with Luma3DS or fastboot3DS. Extract the package, copy open_agb_firm.firm into /luma/payloads/ and merge its 3ds folder at the SD root; hold START at boot to choose it. Supply legally dumped .gba files; no external GBA BIOS download is required. Uses native hardware: no save states or GBA link cable, games over 32 MiB unsupported, sleep mode incomplete and reboot required between games. Back up old /3ds/open_agb_firm/config.ini before recreating it for this changed config format.
